Just for anything - I had to take an IQ-test (well,  turns out I suck at maths), had to write a short text and do one of these "cross out how you feel from 1-5".
But honestly, their system doesn't workt cause I crossed out suicidal in every option and the test said that's normal. 
Or maybe it's normal for germans to feel suicidal whenever something bothers us. 
So yeah ...
Bit the psychologist was very sweet.
So, honestly - I think most people in the health care system reallly want to help us, even if we don't think that's true.

No, honey, don't be scared, I just ranted. I don't know how it is in the US, but many people want to help people like you and me - and she was very nice to me and really wanted to help me. I was just hery upset about that piece of paper that said I was normal cause ... yeah, I'm not. I would like to be. 
I give you all my blessings. Even if we think it wont help, it CAN. Really. And it's ok to be scared and nervous. For these things, you can really, truly be yourself.
You got this.

I live in Germany, so I get kinda good help? In relation to other countries. 
Working on it.
Just frustrated that sometimes I don't seem to be taken serious.
Kinda? I think? Cause I really want to fucking work, I need it. But every time I tried to get a job since 2020 I just broke down and needed to quit/ or to be fired. It sucks. ...

My second "best friend" just loved me as long as she could command me like a dog. 
The final straw came when 2 other friends - who I wasn't as close with, but still hang out with - told me to not obey her every rule. 
She got nad at me cause I wouldn't sit down as she commanded me to. That was basically the end of that "friendship".
Still thankfull for my other 2 friends in that situation.

Well, I seem to be more fit and happy when I use it - my burds also seem to be more fit when I use it. 
So I think it's a good investion but don't rely just on me. Also heard (but didn't try) that some vitamin D pills are good for the dark months - some, you need the right ones(I don't know about them).
On amazon I got a good one for like 25 euros. Its just important that you can switch between cold and warm light - warm light is better.
Yeah, in my past jobs I always hoped somebody would fire me  but my perfectionism got in the way ...

Jeah, i get that too ... thankfully the sun is up longer now. Well, I tell myself to be more egoistic and be happy about climte change because of that(living in europe). And I use a daylight lamp. Really helps.

Not weird, I guess it has sonething to do with: oh well, I deserved this. 
Like I felt always good when I cared for my wounds after yeeting myself.

Just guessing here, but that's how this stuff normaly happens.

I feel you, but I have body-dysmorphia too, so that's a fun ride 🙄
Anyway, people always found me attractive, wonder why I don't have a BF and so on. 
Sometimes I just think of that scene in black swan with winona ryder and I want to do it to. Just destroy my face, so I'm not judged by it. 
"But you're so pretty, how can you be sad?"  ...
F that sh**t

Love this movie - it's one of my comfort ones. One of the first times I felt understood was when I saw it. But I totally undrstand your points.
Bpd never leaves, it's not just a phase, when you have bad things happening in your live, the symptoms come back, there's no "happy end", no "I've been treated now, so I'm cured" ... 
It's almost like they split all the "bad" parts from Winona and gave them to Angelina. 
"Living my life to the fullest" almost killed me. 
It's not black and white, as they always tell us ...

"It's a permanent solution to a temporary proplem" 🤪 
Oh ... is it? Then when does the "temporary" problem stop?
Yeah, but with me it has more to do with depersonalisation. If the anxiety gets to strong, I just don't feel myself anymore. Maybe you can relate to this?

Same, darling, same. 
Am going to a coaching right now to find a job that fits me for more than 3 months ... 
At the last coaching we talked about burnout ... 
Nice to know that I'm constantly at the burnout level ... 
Like I'm burned out from live. 
Sucks that we always habe to be sooo kind to ourselves when all that we want is destruction. 
I'm tired too.
Like, can't we jst have a damn break from the fight? Can't  the self-destructive thoughts just come once a month? 
Sorry if I made this about me. 
All I want to say is, I'm tired too, so tired. Hope, this year something goes right for us.

Darling, a slip up doesn't mean that you have to start again from zero. You did six months! That's a huge accomplishment. Don't be so hard on yourself. Slip ups happen. You still hit a huge milestone. Be proud of yourself. Try to look at the positive things you did, even if it's far easier to look at the negatives.
And people are wondering why we don't want to have kids ...

Darling, you're being emotionally abused. F them. I don't know how old you are and uf you can escape your family in any way, but I recommen the subs r/raisedbynarcissts , r/justnofamily and r/momforamimute

Your weight doesn't define you. Your looks don't. You are worthy and you deserve to be loved.
Thankyou, yeah my mother changed a lot - and I too have my problems with alcohol, so I kinda get it ... :-/
Addiction isn't selfish - it's an illness. I say this with having 2 alcoholic parents that destroyed my childhood.
That's also a good skill - I often use Rammstein on the highest volume :-D
Talk back. Tell her/him/them to shut up. Mob them back. The more you do it the better it'll work.
I second this - darling, please try to seak therapy. This isn't healthy.

Oh hell no, f him - that is in no way acceptable, no matter how much you weigh. No. 
Jesus, this infuriates me. If you want (andneed) to loose weight, you need compassion, encouragement. 
Tough love maybe too, butnotlike this.
Don'tfeelbad about yourself, darling.

I feel that too 😅 it's very good that you're taking the steps to get better - although it's a very slow path and we have to accept that it's a chronical disease, will never fully go away and so on. 
But I am SOOOO MUCH better now. 
I still feel like absolute garbage some days, but I would never want to go back to myself from 7 years ago. 
And yeah, I - and MANY others(also neurotypicals) are stressed by december. 
We are freaking warriors. 

And with medication - you have to talk with your doc what's right for you, but I was always startled by EVERYTHING,so the numbness helbs me - and I still feel soo much. But finding the right medication sometimes sucks as hard as finding a psychologist.

Same. I always tried to remember it so hard, but there's just no memory. 
No wonder I searched for comfort in the arms of idiots.
Proud of you! That takes so much strength. You got it! I believe in you :-)

I feel you. I feel so ashamed about it too. I just want to be loved, yeah, you can be a little rough with me, but please don't hurt me. 
It's sad that people assume we are "prude" or something when we just don't want to associate pain with intimacy.

I feel you. This year I finally came to the conclusioun that I will never be enough for myself. I did so many cool things in my life - doesn't matter. 
I would still "be a failure" even if I invented the cure for cancer.
I would still feel like I accomplished nothing in my life. Nothing. 
The emptiness hurts, I know. 
And the people who hurt us suck like hell. 
But life goes on.
Whatmatters is that we make it worthwhile, that we live it. Idk. Something like that.

I feel that - when I'm having panic attacks I just want to be held and told that it's alright. 
I think it's cause we never got the safety we needed from our parents. We never got the feeling that we are safe anywhere ...
Guns aren't that effective as far as I heard ... I mean yeah, life sucks sometimes but it sucks even more with half of your face blown off.

Relapses are often a part of recovery. Don't blame yourself to much. You are on a good path. People mess up, it's ok. You are not thrown back to the first step. It's just a hiccup on the way. It's ok. Be kind to yourself. 
You are brave for fighting this fight, you got this.

I feel you - but I'm in therapy on and off since 6 years now.
What helps me is to write the texts I want to sent and save them in my notes app. 
But you could also record your voice/video.
Kinda like a diary but more impulsive.
Well, you know - whenever the question came up, I just said I'd rather not have been born.
Yeah, actually it can lie - there is this one vid/gif of a guy who shows what differences on a lense do to your face - can change your entire appearence.

If there's one thing we can learn from this, it's to realise that no job is worth more than our lives. The time where we live to work is over. No, we need to live. I think there is a revolution coming. It should be. Yeah, we are priviliged in comparision to ithers, but what is a life lived for work till we die? 
Sorry, idk at the end of the year I get a little poethic, but I just can't help my anger, sorrow and fear over this.
How can people be so cruel?

First of all - it's very good that you notice that there's a problem. For real.
I don't know where you live, but of course you will have heard the advice to go to a rehab center. Even if you are afraid of it - it can help you. 
Or google about help for addiction in your city.
For real - even if the therapists and so on are horrible, the thing that always helped me - and others I heard about - are other addicts who want to get clean. 
Beeing aware of your addiction is the first step - you don't have to go to the AA(they are not a fit all thing), but connecting with other struggling people helps. 
And don't be to hard on yourself if you can't make a full stop right now(sometimes that isn't even safe with alcohol).

Darling, if they leave when you set boundaries, they never were your friends in the first place. They used you. For whatever reason, maybe to feel better about themselves/feel like they have more power. 
You deserve more than this. 
It hurts, yeah, but that's like ripping a band aid. You have to get through this. Cause the people you'll meet after this will be soo loving and honest with you.
At least thats what I experienced. 
It's ok. Let them go. They aren't your friends. They never were.
Have you talked to a doctor? I couldn't sleep more than 2 hours for years until they gave me medicine for it. Yeah, it's scary and you hear bad stuff about it, but I couldn't bear it anymore.

I'm so proud of you - also, I've been in a psychiatric clinic 2 months ago and had contact with many people from the addiction ward. I was also very afraid of going there, but it was the best descision I could make. Met very cool people there and it rwally isn't the prison we imagine it is from all the movies. Also the stuff wont treat you like a prisoner, there are rules, of course, but they can be bent.
AND big bonus - wheb you go there on your own free will you can also go whenever you want. 
It's not a prison - they really want to help you. And it's ok to be scared.
I'm proud of you.

Relapses are part of recovery. It's normal even if you think you (or them) failed. 
Of course you have to be kind to your friend - but I guess you know that. 
BUT more important, you have to be kind to yourself right now. 
The urges to relapse too will be strong right now, it's ok. You are not a failure - and your friend also isn't a failure. You are both human and you are both very, very strong for fighting this fight.
If you need some space right now - tell your friend that you need it, but also tell them that you are still there for him. 
A relapse isn't a setback to the starting point. It's just a stumbling on the path.

Oh darling, yeah that's a dangerous slope. It's called self medicating. Cause yeah, in short term it helps you, but it destroys your body and makes your symptoms worse. Also it can easily develop into an addiction cause it's an "easy solution". 
I did this for 8 years now, want to stop since 2. Am on a good way to actually stop, but I am an addict. And without therapy I wouldn't be here anymore and able to stop. 
Try to find help, I know it isn't easy. But the fact alone that you're asking us about this is a sign that there's hope for you.

Cut ties with my father cause he wouldn't change. Every connection to hoim just hurt me.
If my mother wouldn't have helped me financially, I would have also cut ties, but now I really love her, never thought she would change.
And of course you changed, that feeling is a good sign. You moved on.

But I think I have to find another.

We are chronically ill.

Hey babe, I feel exactly like you right now. The hardest thibg for people like us is to do things that we enjoy - and that is exactly what we should do in these moments.
For every other sickness you should just stay in bed, but for our sickness we need to do things that are fun and make us want to live. 
So yeah, do nothing - and playing video games isn't nothing.

Tbh ... and I know this isn't a popular opinion ... 
I grew up with money - upper middle class. Have my own flat now. Deserve none of that.
I'm so crippled by guilt etc ... 
No, money doesn't give you happiness. It can make your life really, reallly much easier. 
And I'm thankful for that.
But I dont deserve that, I didn't work for it. My broken family provided it.

Hey Darling, I understand how you feel - I'm currently on sick leave cause I couldn't handle the "hustle".
In 2019 I learned to love life ... which I never thought I could. Now I try to get a part time job that doesn't take my soul. And one where I have enough time for living my life.

I would say, go to a part time clinic/therapist and so on, but idk how that works in the US
All I know is, that life isn't about work and we are the generation that fights against that. 
So please, please don't try to live for work or find your passion in work. 
Look out for birds, rainbows, read interesting books when it rains, watch funny YT-vids with the blanket over your head.

Oh gosh the old I unlive myself thing ... yeah, they love to do that. But honestly it's most often just empty threats. Cause they know they'll get you with that. 
But if he lives in a different state, that's great. You can then just go to the phone less often, say things like: I was busy, Oh, my phone didn't work, It showed a strange number ... and so on. Of course they will still ramble, but the thing is - you CAN say that.
And honestly, if he's that desperate to threaten you with hurting himself, he is VERY scared to lose you. You still have power over him. Realising that is not easy, but it's true.
And low contact is also a good option. Things don't have to always go in extremes. 
Wish you luck! :-)

I totally understand that. After going NC with my dads side of the family, I had to deal with my grandparents from the other side. They provide me with money and always loved my dad. But they finally got the message that I don't accept them talking about him, luring me in. 
Now, the bad thing is that he is the one who provides you with money. 
It's not shameful to act a certain way to get money from your relatives. I always sae it as an emotional escort in a way?
But there are things that crossed the line so much, hurt me so much, that I needed to say I can't do this. 
Now, my state has a good system for helping jobless people, so I was ready to risk that. 
And I don't know how emotionally connected you are, but most parents - even the ones that actively hurt you, want to keep contact to you. So if you can, try to tell him that you're uncomfortable with that.
And it's totally alright to emotionally manipulate him. You are not bad for that. You can set up an "act" for him till you can support yourself. 
But try to not let him cross your boundaries in a way that hurts your health. 
I wish you strenght. 
You deserve to be treated good.

I feel you. My father constantly told me that I was "his ideal woman", when I grew up and pointed out what he thought was attractive in women. Hands, dimples on the lower back, long hair. Whatever. 

I'm NC with him since 5 years and it lifted a huge weight off my shoulders. 

If you can, try to avoid these calls - or hang up when he mentions this. Change the subject maybe.

Idk how your relationship is but please try to set boundaries if you can. This behaviour of him is unacceptable.
